_note: The disposal sink (Complaints/309). Getting rid of a waste is work and ground, not a price: a waste is loaded and tipped (waste_handling_job), carried to a dump (a waste_haulage_tkm technique per carriage mode) and left on ground that stays held while the heap stands (dump_ground_m2). These are services: they make no matter, so they carry service true and each is priced through the same cost routine as any recipe. sim/engine/disposal_cost.py combines their solved prices with a material's bulk density and heap height (data/world/waste_heaps.json) into the cost of disposing of one unit of it, which is the lowest price a waste by-product can take. Where no technique for the services is in a solve, disposal is free. The labour figures are the carriage mode figures of sim/geography (the cheapest technique available wins, as for any good); test_waste_disposal_data checks they still equal the geography module's.

waste_handling_job.basis: one tonne of waste loaded onto the carrier and tipped at the dump
waste_handling_job.yield_basis: The handling_hours_per_tonne of the carriage modes in data/world/geography/route_modes/modes.json (load and unload each time a haul changes mode), one labourer hour per tonne, which covers both the loading at the works and the tipping at the dump.

waste_haulage_on_foot.basis: one tonne of waste carried one kilometre on level ground by porters on foot
waste_haulage_on_foot.yield_basis: crew_hours_per_tonne_km of the foot carriage mode, from sim/geography carriage_rates: porters carry a load of about 27 kg at about 22 km a day over a ten-hour working day. Print it with `python3 -c "from sim.geography import api; print(api.carriage_rates(['foot', 'pack', 'cart']))"`.

waste_haulage_by_pack_animal.basis: one tonne of waste carried one kilometre on level ground by a string of mules
waste_haulage_by_pack_animal.yield_basis: crew_hours_per_tonne_km of the pack carriage mode, from sim/geography carriage_rates (command in waste_haulage_on_foot).

waste_haulage_by_cart.basis: one tonne of waste carried one kilometre on level ground by an ox cart on a track
waste_haulage_by_cart.yield_basis: crew_hours_per_tonne_km of the cart carriage mode, from sim/geography carriage_rates (command in waste_haulage_on_foot).

dump_ground_m2.basis: one square metre of ground held under a heap for one year
dump_ground_m2.yield_basis: A square metre is a ten-thousandth of a hectare; held for a year it ties up that many hectare-years, charged at hectare_land's solved rent like any land use. A heap never gives its ground back, so sim/engine/disposal_cost.py capitalises this yearly price at the interest rate.
